completion_rule: every step receives one allowed disposition; proposing no campaign is a valid result
anti_confabulation_rules: A disposition is required; a positive answer is not.
Do not create evidence to satisfy a checklist field.
Use not_applicable when the item does not bear on this transition.
Use insufficient_evidence when the item is relevant but cannot be established.
Use blocked when safe planning cannot continue.
Only completed_with_evidence permits factual conclusions in the step output.
Every cited artifact identity must resolve in Mission Hub.
A planning job may conclude with no_campaign, prerequisite_work, or campaign_proposal.

steps.instruction: Verify that the previous campaign is closed or explicitly interrupted and that Luna produced its findings index.
Verify that the wiki is valid through the campaign findings handoff.
Give every prior campaign question exactly one epistemic answer and one lifecycle disposition using the registered choices.
Classify proposed work separately by research purpose and execution design.

Apply the evaluation-methodology catalogue: identify applicable tested and untested boundaries, strict-consistency units, controlled ladder axes, matched-support contrasts, atomic prerequisites for composition claims, and contamination risks. Use not_applicable where a layer does not bear on the campaign.
Inspect applicable material collections, image-bank coverage, tools, models, compute, providers, and budget.
When the proposed work resolves an ambiguous observation, state competing explanations and discriminating evidence. Otherwise choose not_applicable.
Design bounded candidates. A single candidate is acceptable when alternatives are genuinely inapplicable; record that disposition rather than inventing one.
When multiple real candidates exist, compare information gain, cost, dependencies, reversibility, and risk. Otherwise choose not_applicable.

Choose no_campaign, prerequisite_work, or campaign_proposal. A prerequisite outcome must emit schema-valid preparation requests; a campaign proposal must emit the exact Luna goals handoff. Commission neither.
